title: Elf Bar Elfa Refillable Pods 2ml - 2 Pods
description: These replacement refillable pods are compatible with the Elfa and Elfa Pro pod kit from Elf Bar. Unlike pods that come prefilled with e-liquid, these empty pods let you explore an endless variety of e-liquid flavours from whatever brand you prefer. Its integrated 1.1ohm coil is perfect for use with Nicotine Salts , 50/50 & High-PG E-liquids, and delivers a crispy, satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) sensation with every puff. When the pod begins to loses flavour, you only need to swap the used pod for a new one. Simple, satisfying and more sustainable than other disposable pod kits, the new Elfa pod kit from Elf Bar is a sleek and lightweight pod kit that would appeal to any vaper. Elfa Disposable Pods are made from high-quality materials and are designed to deliver a consistent and reliable vaping experience. The pods are leak-resistant, ensuring that your e-liquid stays inside the pod and doesn't leak out. This pack contains two replacement refillable 1.1ohm disposable Elfa pods. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
